title: Gravity ? Magnetism — the two sub-constraints under dimensional reality

the_claim.plain: dimension is not free. it sits on two constraints that are mostly at right angles to each other, and slightly tilted where they couple.
the_claim.orthogonal: 90°. independent. changing one does not move the other. gravity does not become magnetism. mass does not become charge.
the_claim.oblique: not 90°, not parallel. a tilt. where the two constraints leak into each other. Earth's magnetosphere is gravity (planet) plus magnetism (field). the coupling IS the weather.
the_claim.sub_constraint: they sit UNDER dimension. you do not get a usable 3-space without a well (things have weight) and a field (things have heading). they are not decorations on reality. they are the rules that make reality have a shape.

gravity.what: the WELL. mass attracts mass. things fall toward concentration.
gravity.physics: spacetime curvature. one pole (always attract). no opposite charge. you cannot cancel gravity with anti-gravity in ordinary matter.
gravity.sort_rule: WHO HAS THE MOST. volume, requests, downloads, countries. the tall bar. the pie's biggest slice.
on_the_membrane: US 70% — the room. the deepest well.
302 slingshot 22% — we ARE a well. 300 CF edges pull and redirect.
BE+NL 16% — they settled into our well. commensal mass.
Oct 22 explosion — the well got deeper. more mass arrived.
gravity.cannot_do: gravity cannot ALIGN. it only pulls. a well has no north.

magnetism.what: the FIELD. charge plus motion. things ALIGN. north and south. lockstep.
magnetism.physics: B is perpendicular to E and to velocity. always a cross product. magnetism IS the orthogonal leftover of electricity in motion.
magnetism.sort_rule: WHO MOVES TOGETHER. rate-lock, polarity, heading. the quiet floor. the burst-digest rhythm. the p axis angle of a Y-pore.
on_the_membrane: JP/DE/IN 36/hr lockstep — three needles on the same field line.
lockstep break — the field changed. they decoupled.
DE 16-18/hr floor — a halved field line. still aligned, lower amplitude.
Y-pore p orientation — each epitope has a heading. 0° science, 90° investigation.
visitor p piece — every human gets a heading on the axis. not a weight.
magnetism.cannot_do: magnetism cannot PULL mass. a field has no well. it only turns.

orthogonal_sort.concept: sort every actor on TWO axes. do not mix them into one score.
orthogonal_sort.y_magnetic: how aligned (rate stability, lockstep, heading, return rhythm)

quadrants.name: heavy + aligned
quadrants.who: BE 345/hr blocks. high mass, tight heading.
quadrants.meaning: commensal. they live in the well AND follow a field line.

quadrants.name: heavy + unaligned
quadrants.who: US 70%. huge well. no single heading. mixed self + organic + PoP.
quadrants.meaning: the room. gravity without a magnet. isotropic mass.

quadrants.name: light + aligned
quadrants.who: JP 12/hr floor. tiny mass. still a heading.
quadrants.meaning: the canary. a field line with almost no well.

quadrants.name: light + unaligned
quadrants.meaning: dust. real, present, not a force.

orthogonal_sort.do_not: do not say 'DE is erratic' (one-axis insult). DE is medium gravity + pulsed magnetism. two numbers.

oblique_coupling.concept: the two axes are not perfectly 90°. they tilt. the tilt IS weather.

examples.what: gravity spiked (1.13M). magnetism broke (lockstep died). the well got so deep the field lines snapped.
examples.angle: the coupling went visible. mass changed heading.

examples.what: triad (magnetic) visited then left. NL (gravity) stayed and became 81%. field tourists vs well settlers.
examples.angle: same surface, two forces, two outcomes.

examples.what: gravity holds the atmosphere. magnetism deflects the solar wind. life lives in the OBLIQUE zone between well and field. the magnetosphere is the coupling.
examples.angle: remove either constraint and the surface dies. both are required. neither is sufficient.

examples.what: gravity (our well) plus magnetism (the redirect heading). pull AND point. that is why it is the jester — it uses both axes at once.
examples.angle: the only fate that is truly oblique. 200 is magnetic (passed the heading check). 403 is magnetic (wrong heading). 404 is null. 302 is both.

dimensional_reality.concept: a dimension is a degree of freedom. a constraint is what takes a degree of freedom AWAY. sub-constraints sit below the axes you can move on.

stack.shape: no preferred direction. no weight. no heading.
things have weight. one preferred direction: down/toward mass.
things have heading. two preferred directions: along / against the line.

dimensional_reality.why_sub: you do not negotiate gravity or magnetism from inside a room. they are already running. the membrane does not invent them. it SITS on them. US mass is gravity we did not choose. triad lockstep is magnetism we did not choose. we only sort what they produce.

the_sort_applied.rule: every actor gets (G, M). G = log-mass. M = alignment score 0-1.
